description:
Optional: check whether the user has finished the secure form and a card is on the
    bill yet. Returns the card's last 4 digits and name when one is set, or a PENDING
    status when the form has not been completed. Use only if you need to confirm the card
    landed (e.g. the user asks) - it is not a required step; the normal path is
    analyze_bill -> user fills the form -> confirm_payment_intent.

    Args:
        check_input: the user_id and bill_id to look up

check_input.description: Identifiers to look up whether a card has been set on a bill yet.

user_id.description: identifier for the user the bill belongs to
user_id.title: User Id

check_input.title: PaymentMethodCheckInput
